translationRepairs: Enraged, Zhang Juzheng prompted the supervising secretaries Wang Daocheng and the censor Xie Siqi to dredge up other charges against him and compelled him to resign and retire.
Enraged, Zhang Juzheng prompted the supervising secretary Wang Daocheng and the censor Xie Siqi to dredge up other charges against him and compelled him to resign and retire.
給事中王道成 is one supervising secretary.
Guoguang submitted a memorial asking that procedures be consolidated, cutting redundant paperwork by roughly a third to a half, and contemporaries hailed the reform as a welcome simplification.
Guoguang submitted a memorial asking that procedures be consolidated, cutting redundant paperwork by thirty to forty percent, and contemporaries hailed the reform as a welcome simplification.
十三四 means three or four tenths.
He was appointed supervising secretary in the Bureau of Military Affairs and was the first to impeach Minister of Personnel Li Mo.
He was appointed supervising secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for War and was the first to impeach Minister of Personnel Li Mo.
兵科 is the Office of Scrutiny for War.
He rose to chief supervising secretary of the Bureau of Personnel.
He rose to chief supervising secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel.
吏科 is the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel.

A month later, censor Jiang Dongzhi charged that Menglong had secured the Ministry of Personnel through bribery arranged by Xu Jue and had betrothed his granddaughter to Xu Jue's younger brother as a wife for his son; censors Deng Lian and Zhao Kai joined the attack, and Menglong was ordered to retire.

A month later, censor Jiang Dongzhi charged that Menglong had secured the Ministry of Personnel by having Xu Jue bribe Feng Bao, and had betrothed his granddaughter as daughter-in-law to Feng Bao's younger brother; censors Deng Lian and Zhao Kai joined the attack, and Menglong was ordered to retire.
保 is the eunuch Feng Bao, not Xu Jue.

Before long, supervising secretary Guang Mao argued: "These were tribes that had submitted and been settled within the defenses; Vice Commander Tao Chengyong had feigned a reward distribution to launch a surprise attack. He should be punished for slaughtering those who had surrendered."

Before long, supervising secretary Guang Mao argued: "These were tribes that had submitted and been settled within the defenses; Mobile Corps Commander Tao Chengyong had feigned a reward distribution to launch a surprise attack. He should be punished for slaughtering those who had surrendered."
遊擊 is Mobile Corps Commander.
He was promoted to supervising secretary in the Bureau of Military Affairs.

兵科 is the Office of Scrutiny for War.
He was promoted to supervising secretary in the Bureau of Revenue.
He was promoted to supervising secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Revenue.
戶科 is the Office of Scrutiny for Revenue.
He rose in successive steps to chief supervising secretary in the Bureau of Rites.
He rose in successive steps to chief supervising secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Rites.
禮科 is the Office of Scrutiny for Rites.
Having crossed the Ministry of Personnel, he was sent out as surveillance commissioner of Shanxi.
Having crossed the Ministry of Personnel, he was sent out as assistant surveillance commissioner of Shanxi.
僉事 is assistant surveillance commissioner.
In the summer of the seventeenth year the emperor had long absent himself from court; court and country alike suspected he was feigning illness because Zhang Jin had not been appointed.
In the summer of the seventeenth year the emperor had long absent himself from court; court and country alike suspected he was feigning illness because Zhang Jing had not been employed.
張鯨 is the eunuch Zhang Jing.
Censors Zuo Zongyi and Li Pei then impeached Dai for setting a disgraceful example; Dai pleaded illness and asked to resign.
Censors Zuo Zongying and Li Pei then impeached Dai for setting a disgraceful example; Dai pleaded illness and asked to resign.
左宗郢 is romanized Zuo Zongying.

A man named Zhu Longguang denounced Li Rusong for colluding with Japanese pirates and had him imprisoned; he also had Rusong's associate Chen Zhongdeng shackled in the noonday sun, to be banished to a malarial region when the sentence expired.

A man named Zhu Longguang accused Li Rusong of colluding with the Japanese and was handed over to the authorities; he and his associate Chen Zhongdeng were cangued under the blazing sun, to be banished to a malarial region when the term expired.
下吏 and the cangue apply to the accuser Zhu Longguang and his associate, not to Li Rusong.
In the second month of the fortieth year Sun Buyang left office, and Huan was shifted to acting minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
In the second month of the fortieth year Sun Piyang left office, and Huan was shifted to acting minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
孫丕揚 is romanized Sun Piyang.
The emperor was shamed by this.
By established custom, transfers of censorial officials required consultation with the Censorate and the Ministry of Personnel's personnel section; Zheng Jizhi did not permit them to be informed.
By established custom, transfers of censorial officials required consultation with the Censorate and the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel; Zheng Jizhi did not permit them to be informed.
吏科 is the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel.

When censorial posts came up for selection, Secretariat drafter Zhang Guangfang and magistrates Zhao Yunchang, Zhang Tinggong, Kuang Mingluan, and Pu Zhongyu should have been among the candidates; but because they were perceived as leaning toward Yu Li and Li Sancai, they were passed over and reassigned to ministry clerkships.

When censorial posts came up for selection, Secretariat drafter Zhang Guangfang and magistrates Zhao Yunchang, Zhang Tinggong, Kuang Mingluan, and Pu Zhongyu should have been among the candidates; but because they were perceived as leaning toward Yu Yuli and Li Sancai, they were passed over and reassigned to ministry clerkships.
於玉立 is Yu Yuli; 於 is his surname.

Censors Sun Juxiang, Zhang Wudian, and Zhou Qiyuan thereupon protested on grounds of the annual rotation precedent and argued that Zhang Guangfang and the other four had been wronged; Li Jin, chief supervising secretary of the personnel section, also submitted a forceful memorial impeaching Wang Dazhi for abuse of office.

Censors Sun Juxiang, Zhang Wudian, and Zhou Qiyuan thereupon protested on grounds of the annual rotation precedent and argued that Zhang Guangfang and the other four had been wronged; Li Jin, chief supervising secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel, also submitted a forceful memorial impeaching Wang Dazhi for abuse of office.
吏科 is the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel.

The following February, with Hu Laichao as director of the Appointment Bureau, Chief Supervising Secretary Zhang Guoru and Censors Ma Mengzhen and Xu Liangyan were transferred to outside posts—again without consulting the Censorate or the personnel section.

The following February, with Hu Laichao as director of the Appointment Bureau, Zhang Guoru, chief supervising secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for War, and Censors Ma Mengzhen and Xu Liangyan were transferred to outside posts—again without consulting the Censorate or the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel.
兵科都給事中 is chief supervising secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for War; 吏科 is the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel.
Han Guangyu of the personnel section and Censor Xu Yangliang raised mild objections, but they stood alone and ultimately could not prevail.
Han Guangyu of the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel and Censor Xu Yangliang raised mild objections, but they stood alone and ultimately could not prevail.
吏科 is the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel.
